messages.subject: Re: Thank you, Hannaford - a New England Caroline's Cart resource to share
messages.body_text:
Hello Hannaford and Red Thread PR team,

One little family story to add to my earlier note: we’ve just published a Saturday breakfast picnic from our off-season trip to Wells, Maine, with Hannaford at the heart of it.

Read the story: https://anausomelife.com/hannaford-maine-breakfast-picnic.html

We picked up muffins, chocolate-frosted donuts, cold brew and Oakhurst eggnog, then found a picnic table by the water. We’d brought our own plates and glasses, so we made eggnog cold brews while James enjoyed his eggnog on its own.

Hannaford has been a familiar pleasure since my years in Vermont. James loves grocery shopping so much that other shoppers commented, and we proudly shared that he is often the grocery-store trip leader in his classroom. My favorite butter rum muffins were sold out, but we found plenty else to enjoy.

We enjoyed breakfast so much that we forgot to take a waterfront photo! The piece includes our original shopping photographs, a captioned editorial watercolor and a simple picnic idea other families can borrow.

Please share the story link with your social and community teams. We’d love to see it passed along through Hannaford’s channels. The page includes suggested captions and two downloadable text graphics for organic social sharing with An AUsome Life / @anausomelife credit and a link.

Sharing captions and graphics: https://anausomelife.com/hannaford-maine-breakfast-picnic.html#share-this-story

Thank you for being part of a lovely Maine morning.

Warmly,
An AUsome Life

messages.subject: It’s never off-season for eggnog: Oakhurst in our Wells breakfast story
messages.body_text:
Hi Belinda,

We’ve just published a little family story featuring Oakhurst eggnog, and I thought you and the Oakhurst social team would enjoy it.

During our off-season trip to Wells, Maine, we picked up Oakhurst eggnog at Hannaford and found a picnic table by the water. We’d brought our own plates and glasses, so we made eggnog cold brews while our son James enjoyed his eggnog on its own.

Read the story: https://anausomelife.com/hannaford-maine-breakfast-picnic.html

We enjoyed breakfast so much that we forgot to take a waterfront photo. Alongside our original shopping photographs, the story includes a captioned editorial watercolor inspired by the morning, with an Oakhurst eggnog jug and the line: “It’s never off-season for eggnog.”

It’s an easy little family outing idea: pick up breakfast, bring a few familiar things for the table and find somewhere lovely to sit together.

We’d love for Oakhurst to share the story link through its social and community channels. The page includes suggested captions and two downloadable text graphics for organic social sharing with An AUsome Life / @anausomelife credit and a link.

Sharing captions and graphics: https://anausomelife.com/hannaford-maine-breakfast-picnic.html#share-this-story

Thank you for being part of our Maine breakfast!

Warmly,
An AUsome Life
